name: FED 5310
title: Field Education Seminar III
description: This seminar helps students prepare for and make optimum use of their field education experience. Topics include the roles and responsibilities of the student within the agency setting, exploration and development of learning contracts, and the educational assessment of self as a learner in the profession.  The seminar is used to identify issues that arise in the field and ways to deal with them. Required course for students in the M.S.W. Program.
requirement_description: Open to students in the MSW program.
